title: Wheat yields in Norfolk, 1250 to 1854
description: Bar chart of wheat yields in Norfolk in bushels per acre, from Mark Overton's Table 3 (1996): 15 in 1250–1349, 12 in 1350–1449, 15 in 1584–1640, 15 in 1660–1739, 23 in 1836 and 30 in 1854. Turnips and clover were 0 percent of the sown area until 1640, 7 and 2 percent in 1660–1739, and 24 and 25 percent in 1836.
heading: NORFOLK WHEAT · BUSHELS PER ACRE
